info.title: Aura Historia Partner Product API Reference
info.description: Generated subset of the Aura Historia OpenAPI specification containing only the partner product batch endpoints and the components they require.

put.description:
Creates new product-listings or updates existing ones for a listing source in a single batch call,
using bearer authentication. This endpoint is intended for partnerships and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the listing source, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `product-listings:write` scope.
Allowed callers are Aura Historia admins and users partnered with the target listing source.

The request body is an array of `UpsertProductListingData` objects. Each entry is upserted
synchronously in its own PostgreSQL transaction. For each entry:
- **New listing** — omitted or `null` availability, price, and estimates create no value; `auction` is omitted or an asserted nested Auction/lot-facts patch (not `null`).
- **Existing listing** — availability, price, and each price estimate
  are tri-state: omitted preserves, `null` clears, and a concrete value replaces. Omit `auction` to preserve it; `auction: null` is invalid. Within an asserted Auction/lot-facts patch, each lot/timing leaf is tri-state: omit to preserve, `null` to clear clearable leaves, or provide a value to set. `auctionId` must name an existing Auction for this ListingSource; omit it to preserve membership, send `null` to clear it, or send an ID to set it. A withdrawn
  listing is restored before current facts apply.
- `title` and `description` apply only on creation. For an
  existing listing they preserve current state and emit no current-state history event.
- `images` is separate: omit to preserve, send `[]` to clear, or send an array to replace.
  `null` is invalid. `url` is non-clearable: omit or send `null` to preserve it; send a URL
  value to replace it.

The response returns HTTP 200 with failures as `{ listingSourceId, sourceListingId, error }` objects when
one or more entries succeed. `error` is the stable API error key for that entry. If every non-empty entry fails, the first failure is returned
as a problem response. An empty array is accepted and returns `[]`.

parameters.name: listingSourceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the target ListingSource

requestBody.description: Array of at most 100 product-listings to upsert synchronously. May be empty.

description.text: A beautiful 18th-century baroque violin in excellent condition.

update_existing.summary: Update an existing product while leaving the current price unchanged

200.description:
Batch upsert completed synchronously. This response is returned when all entries
succeed or when at least one entry succeeds; it lists only failed entries.

partial_failure.summary: Some product-listings failed while at least one product was upserted

400.description: Bad request — request body is missing, empty, or contains invalid JSON

missing_body.summary: Request body is absent or empty

invalid_json.summary: Request body is not valid JSON

401.description:
Unauthorized — the bearer token is missing, invalid, expired, or the referenced
Aura Historia access token no longer exists.

access_token_not_found.summary: Aura Historia access token is unknown or expired

403.description: Forbidden — the authenticated caller is not allowed to ingest product-listings for this listing source

404.description: Not found — the specified listing source does not exist

503.description: Service unavailable — all entries encountered a temporary product-write failure

post.description:
Creates one or more product-listings for a listing source using bearer authentication.
This endpoint is intended for partnerships and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the listing source, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `product-listings:write` scope.
Allowed callers are Aura Historia admins and users partnered with the target listing source.

The request body is an array of `CreateProductListingData` objects. Each entry is created
synchronously in its own PostgreSQL transaction.

The response returns HTTP 200 with failures as `{ listingSourceId, sourceListingId, error }` objects when
one or more entries succeed. `error` is the stable API error key for that entry. If every non-empty entry fails, the first failure is returned
as a problem response. An empty array is accepted and returns `[]`.

patch.description:
Updates one or more existing product-listings for a listing source using bearer authentication.
This endpoint is intended for partnerships and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the listing source, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `product-listings:write` scope.
Allowed callers are Aura Historia admins and users partnered with the target listing source.

The request body is an array of `UpdateProductListingData` objects. Omitted fields are unchanged;
`null` clears availability and price. Omit `auction` to preserve its context; `auction: null`, `url: null`,
and `images: null` return `400 BAD_BODY_VALUE`; send `[]` to remove all images. Within an asserted `auction`,
omit a leaf to preserve it, send `null` to clear a clearable lot/timing leaf, or send a value to set it.
`auction.auctionId` must name an existing Auction for this ListingSource. Omit it to preserve membership, send
`null` to clear membership, or send an ID to set it. The complete batch contract is
validated before any entry is applied synchronously in its own PostgreSQL transaction.

The response returns HTTP 200 with failures as `{ listingSourceId, sourceListingId, error }` objects when
one or more entries succeed. `error` is the stable API error key for that entry. If every non-empty entry fails, the first failure is returned
as a problem response. An empty array is accepted and returns `[]`.

BearerAuth.description:
Cognito JWT bearer token.
This scheme is used for authenticated user routes and for partner routes that accept Cognito user tokens.

AccessTokenAuth.description:
Aura Historia bearer access token created through `/api/v1/me/access-tokens`.
Tokens are sent as standard bearer authorization headers.
Selected partner routes accept this scheme instead of the removed partner API-key flow.

oneOf.description: User ID of the user who performed the change.

ActorData.description:
Audit actor encoded as a plain string.
Values are either the literal `SYSTEM` or the User ID of the acting user.

ProductListingSummaryData.description: Lightweight ProductListing summary for search and similar-listing results.

productListingTitleSlugId.description: Immutable Aura-owned public locator. Omitted when the listing is redacted as hidden.

auctionId.description: Indexed Auction TypeID association. Omitted when this listing has no Auction association; search and similar results do not hydrate current Auction metadata.

ProductListingDetailsData.description: Canonical ProductListing detail inside a personalized response wrapper.

productListingTitleSlugId.description: Immutable Aura-owned public locator. Omitted when the listing is redacted as hidden.

auction.description: Current parent Auction presentation from the joined PostgreSQL detail read. Null when the listing has no parent Auction.

lot.description: Listing-owned lot facts. Null when the listing has no lot facts.

ProductListingLotData.description: Listing-owned lot facts. These facts may exist without a parent Auction.

PersonalizedProductListingDetailsData.description: Canonical Product detail with optional user-specific state.

userState.description: Present only for a valid user or delegated-user bearer token.

PersonalizedProductListingSummaryData.description: Canonical Product summary with optional user-specific state.

userState.description: Present only for a valid user or delegated-user bearer token.

items.description: Personalized Product summaries in OpenSearch result order.

size.description: Requested page size after server-side clamping.

total.description: Total matching product-listings for BM25 search when the backend provides it. Hybrid BM25 plus KNN search omits this value because its fused candidate pool is not a reliable total.

searchAfter.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. It must be sent back as one JSON-encoded `searchAfter` query value.

fxRateId.description: Persisted FX snapshot used for active Product filtering and display values in this cursor chain.

ProductListingUserStateData.description: User-specific state information for a product

WatchlistUserStateData.description: Watchlist-specific user state for a product

watching.description: Whether the product is on the user's watchlist

notifications.description: Whether notifications are enabled for this watchlist product

ContentVisibilityUserStateData.description: Stored viewer preference used when presenting unassessed or sensitive listing content.

showUnassessedOrSensitiveContent.description: Whether unassessed or sensitive content may be shown to this viewer.

NotificationUserStateData.description: Unseen notification IDs for this product, ordered newest first.

unseenNotificationIds.description: Every unseen Notification ID for this product. Empty when none exist.

SearchFilterUserStateData.description:
User's saved-search-filter match state for a product.
When `matched` is `true`, at least one of the user's saved search filters matched this product.
`userSearchFilterId`, `userSearchFilterName`, `matchReason`, and `matchFeedback` are only
present when `matched` is `true`.
Defaults to `matched: false` when the user has no saved search filters or none of them matched.
When `hidden` is `true`, the match exceeds the user's monthly search-filter match quota and the
product data is anonymized (valid synthetic object IDs, placeholder title, unknown enums, nulled timestamps).
Only matches ranked beyond the quota (by ascending match creation time) are hidden;
the first N matches (where N is the user's tier quota) remain fully visible.

matched.description: Whether any of the user's saved search filters matched this product. Defaults to `false`.

hidden.description:
Whether this match is hidden because the user has exceeded their monthly search-filter match quota.
When `true`, the product data in the response is anonymized: object-ID fields are replaced with valid synthetic IDs using their documented prefixes,
the title becomes a language-specific placeholder, enum fields are set to their unknown variants, optional fields are omitted, and
timestamps are set to the Unix epoch.
Defaults to `false`.

userSearchFilterId.description:
The ID of the saved search filter that matched this product.
Present only when `matched` is `true`; omitted otherwise.

userSearchFilterName.description:
The user-defined name of the saved search filter that matched this product.
Present only when `matched` is `true`; omitted otherwise.

matchReason.description:
A human-readable explanation of why the saved search filter matched this product.
Only set for AI-enhanced filters (i.e. those with `search.enhancedSearchDescription`).
Present only when `matched` is `true` and an enhanced match reason exists; omitted otherwise.
matchReason.example: Product matches the vintage Art Deco style described in your search filter.

matchFeedback.description:
Optional feedback previously recorded by the authenticated user for this saved-search match.
Present only when `matched` is `true` and feedback has been explicitly stored for the match.
`true` marks the match as relevant, `false` marks it as not relevant.

amount.description: Price amount in minor currency units (e.g., cents for most supported currencies, whole yen for JPY)

ProductListingHistoryEntryData.description: One immutable committed ProductListing domain-history entry.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this committed event

LanguageData.description:
Supported language codes (ISO 639-1 canonical values):
- de: German (includes de-DE, de-AT, de-CH, de-LU, de-LI)
- en: English (includes en-US, en-GB, en-AU, en-CA, en-NZ, and backend-specific accepted alias en_IE)
- fr: French (includes fr-FR, fr-CA, fr-BE, fr-CH, fr-LU)
- es: Spanish (includes es-ES, es-MX, es-AR, es-CO, es-CL, es-PE, es-VE)
- it: Italian (includes it-IT, it-CH)
- zh: Chinese (Simplified) (includes zh-CN, zh-Hans)
- pt: Portuguese (includes pt-PT, pt-BR)
- pl: Polish (includes pl-PL)
- tr: Turkish (includes tr-TR)
- nl: Dutch (includes nl-NL, nl-BE)
- cs: Czech (includes cs-CZ)
- ja: Japanese (includes ja-JP)
- ru: Russian (includes ru-RU)
- ar: Arabic (includes ar-SA, ar-EG, ar-AE)

`de`, `en`, `fr`, `es`, and `it` are fully supported localization/translation-target languages.
`zh`, `pt`, `pl`, `tr`, `nl`, `cs`, `ja`, `ru`, and `ar` are ingestion-only languages:
they can appear in stored/native content and are accepted anywhere `LanguageData` is used,
but backend-generated translations and fallback localized strings are not produced in these languages.

MeasurementUnitData.description:
User preference for distance/size presentation:
- METRIC: Metric units.
- IMPERIAL: Imperial units.

ListingAvailabilityData.description: Current reliable source assertion of listing purchase availability. Omitted or `null` means Aura has no reliable current assertion.

ListingOrderabilityData.description: Broad classification derived from a concrete availability assertion; it is not independently stored.

ListingLifecycleData.description:
Source-catalog membership of a ProductListing:
- ACTIVE: The listing is currently offered by its authoritative source.
- WITHDRAWN: The listing is retained for history but is no longer offered.

ProductListingAuctionData.description: Partner ProductListing nested write patch. `auctionId` must identify an existing Auction for the same ListingSource. Omit it to preserve membership, send null to clear membership, or send a value to set it. Omit a lot/timing leaf to preserve it, send null to clear a clearable leaf, or send a value to set it.

auctionId.description: Existing same-ListingSource Aura Auction TypeID. Omit to preserve membership; send null to clear it.

lotNumber.description: Omit to preserve the lot label; send null to clear it; send a value to set it.

cataloguePosition.description: Omit to preserve the catalogue position; send null to clear it; send a value to set it.

ProductListingAuctionFactsData.description: Immutable historical listing-owned Auction and lot facts. Their presence has no separate meaning. They never expose a source Auction key or shared Auction metadata.

auctionId.description: Resolved Aura Auction TypeID. Omitted when no resolved membership is present.

ProductListingAuctionTimesData.description: Omit each leaf to preserve it; send null to clear it; values are RFC3339 instants.

PriceEstimateData.description:
Price estimate range for a product.
Contains optional minimum and maximum estimated prices.

min.description: Optional minimum estimated price for the product

max.description: Optional maximum estimated price for the product

PricingData.description:
Complete pricing information for a product.
Contains both the offer price and optional price estimates.

offer.description:
The actual offer or asking price for the product.
This is the price at which the product is currently being sold.

estimate.description:
Optional price estimate range.
Common for auction items where an estimated value range is provided.

url.description: URL to the product image, or `null` when it is not shown to this viewer.

ContentPolicyData.description: Listing-level content decision. This schema is used only when the listing has an assessment.

SortProductListingFieldData.description:
Fields available for sorting:
- score: Sort by relevance score (default, only available when searching with text query)
- updated: Sort by last updated timestamp
- created: Sort by creation timestamp

ProductListingHistoryPayloadData.description: Immutable semantic history payload. It never contains image URLs or enrichment data.

changes.description: Deterministic semantic-change order: main price, minimum estimate, maximum estimate, availability, URL, images, auction, lifecycle, sale observation.

title.description: HTTP status code in human-readable form

ApiErrorSource.description: Information about the source of the error

field.description: Name of the field that caused the error

type.description: Type of parameter that caused the error

ProductListingSearchData.description: ProductListing search criteria used by saved search filters.

auctionId.description: Exact resolved Auction membership IDs. Omit to preserve; `null` clears.

PostUserSearchFilterData.description: Request body for creating a new search filter

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter (max 255 characters, will be truncated if longer)

PatchUserSearchFilterData.description:
Partial search filter update data.
All fields are optional and only provided fields will be updated.
Can update the search filter name, notifications preference, activation state, and/or the search filter criteria.

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter (max 255 characters, will be truncated if longer)

notifications.description:
Whether to enable or disable email notifications for new product-listings matching this search filter.
When `true`, the user will be notified when a new product matches this filter.
When `false`, no notifications are sent for this filter.
Omit to leave unchanged.

state.description:
Optional activation state update for this saved search filter.
`ACTIVE` reactivates the filter if the current user tier still permits the configured search features and quota.
`INACTIVE_BY_USER` manually disables the filter.
Omit to leave the current state unchanged.

search.description: Partial search filter criteria to update

PatchUserSearchFilterMatchData.description:
Partial update payload for a saved-search product match.
Omitting `feedback` leaves the stored match feedback unchanged.

feedback.description:
Optional relevance feedback for the matched product.
`true` marks the product as relevant to the saved search filter, `false` marks it as not relevant.

PatchProductListingSearchData.description: Partial ProductListing search criteria. Omitted fields are unchanged. `enhancedSearchDescription`, `auctionId`, price, date ranges, and the availability query may be cleared with `null`; availability, orderability, and includeUnspecifiedAvailability` must be supplied together or all be `null`.

auctionId.description: Exact resolved Auction membership IDs. Values use strict `auc_` TypeIDs and OR together.

UserSearchFilterData.description: Complete user search filter with metadata

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns this search filter

userSearchFilterId.description: Unique identifier for this search filter

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter

notifications.description:
Whether notifications are enabled for this search filter.
When `true`, the user will be notified when a new product matches this filter.
When `false`, no notifications are sent for this filter.
Defaults to `true` for newly created filters.

created.description: When the search filter was created (RFC3339 format)

updated.description: When the search filter was last updated (RFC3339 format)

ResourceStateData.description:
Activation state of a stored user-owned resource such as a saved search filter.
`ACTIVE` resources are eligible for their normal runtime behavior.
`INACTIVE_BY_USER` resources were explicitly deactivated by the user.
`INACTIVE_BY_RESTRICTED_PLAN` resources remain stored but are inactive because the user's current tier no longer allows them to stay active.

PatchResourceStateData.description:
Client-settable activation state for resources that support manual activation toggles.
Clients may reactivate a resource with `ACTIVE` or manually disable it with `INACTIVE_BY_USER`.
`INACTIVE_BY_RESTRICTED_PLAN` is managed internally by the backend and is never accepted from clients.

SearchFilterProductMatchData.description: Persisted match record for one of a user's saved search filters.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the matched search filter.

userSearchFilterId.description: Unique identifier of the saved search filter that matched the product.

userSearchFilterName.description: Saved-search name captured with the match, when available.

productListingId.description: Unique internal identifier of the matched product.

originEventId.description: Product event that produced this match.

enhancedMatchReason.description: Enhanced-match explanation, when matching supplied one.
enhancedMatchReason.example: The product matches the saved enhanced description.

feedback.description: Optional feedback recorded by the user for this saved-search match.

created.description: When the search-filter product match was originally created (RFC3339 format).

updated.description: When the search-filter product match was last updated (RFC3339 format).

RangeQueryUInt64.description: Range query for numeric values in minor currency units for the selected indexed currency; no request-time conversion occurs

RangeQueryDateTime.description: Range query for date and time values

min.description: Minimum date and time (inclusive, RFC3339 format)

max.description: Maximum date and time (inclusive, RFC3339 format)

UserSearchFilterCollectionData.description: Paginated collection of user search filters with flattened pagination

items.description: Array of search filters in the current page

size.description: Number of product-listings in the current page

total.description: Total number of product-listings matching the query

AccessTokenScopeData.description:
Aura Historia access-token and OAuth scope string.
The value is one of the capabilities supported by the canonical access-token and OAuth flows.

AccessTokenTypeData.description: Token type returned for Aura Historia access tokens.

AdminAccessTokenCollectionData.description:
Cursor-paginated, secret-free access-token metadata for an administrator's explicit target user.
`searchAfter` is a `[created RFC3339 timestamp, AccessToken ID]` cursor and is omitted
when the current page is terminal. The cursor timestamp is not returned as item metadata.
This schema intentionally has no raw token, masked token, short-token, or token-hash property.

items.description: Access-token metadata returned for the target user, including expired and current tokens.

size.description: Requested page size after server-side clamping.

searchAfter.description: `[created RFC3339 timestamp, AccessToken ID]` cursor for the next page, omitted when no more results are available.

AdminAccessTokenData.description:
Secret-free Aura Historia access-token metadata returned by the admin target-user listing.
The representation contains no raw token, masked token, short-token, or token-hash value.
`expires` is omitted when the token has no expiration and is returned for both expired and current tokens.

userId.description: Explicit target user who owns the access token.

accessTokenId.description: Unique identifier of the access token.

name.description: User-defined display name of the access token.

origin.description: Origin recorded by the canonical access-token model.

expires.description: Optional RFC3339 expiration timestamp; expired and current tokens are both listed.

accessTokenId.description: Unique identifier of the access token.

name.description: User-defined display name of the access token.

scope.description: Granted access-token scopes. Omitted when the token has no scopes.

token.description:
Plaintext or masked bearer token value.
Create responses return the full token once; subsequent reads return a masked value such as `aurahistoria_abcdefghijk_****`.

expiresAt.description: Optional absolute expiration timestamp in RFC 3339 format.

expiresIn.description: Optional non-negative number of seconds remaining until expiry.

createdBy.description: Actor who created this access token

updatedBy.description: Actor who last updated this access token

created.description: Timestamp when the access token was created.

updated.description: Timestamp when the access token metadata was last updated.

PostAccessTokenData.description: Request body for creating an Aura Historia access token.

name.description: User-defined display name of the new access token.

scope.description: Optional scopes granted to the access token. Defaults to an empty set.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp in RFC 3339 format.

PatchAccessTokenData.description:
Request body for updating access-token metadata.
Omitted fields remain unchanged. `expires: null` clears the expiry; `name` and `scopes`
reject null, and `scopes: []` replaces the scope set with an empty set.

accessTokenId.description: Unique identifier of the access token to update.

name.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Null is invalid.

scopes.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send `[]` to empty the set; null is invalid.

expires.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send null to clear the expiration timestamp.

OAuthClientMetadataRequestData.description:
Request body for creating OAuth client metadata.
`redirect_uris` must contain at least one HTTPS redirect URI.

client_name.description: Display name of the OAuth client.

tos_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the OAuth client's terms-of-service document.

policy_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the OAuth client's privacy policy document.

client_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the OAuth client's homepage or product site.

logo_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the OAuth client's logo image.

redirect_uris.description: Registered HTTPS redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

scope.description: Optional allowed scopes for tokens issued to this OAuth client.

OAuthClientMetadataPatchData.description:
Request body for updating OAuth client metadata. Omitted properties remain unchanged;
every explicit null is invalid because metadata values are non-nullable.

client_name.description: Optional replacement display name for the OAuth client.

tos_uri.description: Optional replacement terms-of-service document URL for the OAuth client.

policy_uri.description: Optional replacement privacy-policy document URL for the OAuth client.

client_uri.description: Optional replacement homepage or product-site URL for the OAuth client.

logo_uri.description: Optional replacement logo image URL for the OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: Optional replacement set of registered HTTPS redirect URIs.

scope.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send `[]` to replace with an empty set; null is invalid.

OAuthClientMetadataResponseData.description:
OAuth client metadata create response.
`client_secret` contains the plaintext secret only in the create response.
Admin list, detail, and update responses use `OAuthClientAdminData` and omit `client_secret` entirely.

client_secret.description:
Plaintext OAuth client secret returned only once by the create response.
Admin list, detail, and update responses omit this property entirely.

client_name.description: Display name of the OAuth client.

tos_uri.description: Terms-of-service document URL registered for the OAuth client.

policy_uri.description: Privacy-policy document URL registered for the OAuth client.

client_uri.description: Homepage or product-site URL registered for the OAuth client.

logo_uri.description: Logo image URL registered for the OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: Registered redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

scope.description: Allowed scopes for tokens issued to this OAuth client.

client_id_issued_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the OAuth client was created and its client ID was issued.

OAuthClientAdminCollectionData.description:
Cursor-paginated OAuth client summaries for the administrator collection endpoint.
`searchAfter` is a `[created RFC3339 timestamp, OAuthClient ID]` cursor and is omitted
when the current page is terminal. The collection and its items never contain client
secret plaintext, secret hashes, or masked secret values.

items.description: OAuth client summaries returned in the current page.

size.description: Requested page size after server-side clamping.

searchAfter.description: `[created RFC3339 timestamp, OAuthClient ID]` cursor for the next page, omitted when no more results are available.

total.description: Total matching OAuth clients when provided by the reader; omitted otherwise.

OAuthClientAdminData.description:
Secret-free OAuth client metadata returned by the admin OAuth client collection,
detail, and update endpoints under `/api/v1/admin/oauth-clients`.
This schema intentionally has no `client_secret` property.

client_name.description: Display name of the OAuth client.

tos_uri.description: Terms-of-service document URL registered for the OAuth client.

policy_uri.description: Privacy-policy document URL registered for the OAuth client.

client_uri.description: Homepage or product-site URL registered for the OAuth client.

logo_uri.description: Logo image URL registered for the OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: Registered redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

scope.description: Allowed scopes for tokens issued to this OAuth client.

client_id_issued_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the OAuth client was created and its client ID was issued.

OAuthTokenResponseData.description:
Token response returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/token` and
`GET /api/v1/oauth/tokens/by-third-party-code/{thirdPartyCode}`.
The `access_token` is an Aura Historia bearer access token. `expires_in` is omitted
(`null`) for non-expiring tokens. `third_party_exchange_code` is only present on the
direct token exchange response.

access_token.description: The issued Aura Historia access token (plaintext bearer value).

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires. `null` when the token does not expire.

scope.description: Space-separated list of scopes granted to the access token.

third_party_exchange_code.description:
Optional one-time exchange code returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/token`.
It can be redeemed once via `GET /api/v1/oauth/tokens/by-third-party-code/{thirdPartyCode}`
within 60 seconds to obtain the same access token.

OAuthIntrospectionResponseData.description:
Introspection response returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/introspect` (RFC 7662).
When `active` is `false` all other fields are omitted.
When `active` is `true` the available token metadata is populated.

active.description: Whether the token is currently active (not expired, not revoked, and known to this server).

scope.description: Space-separated list of scopes granted to the token. Present only when `active` is `true`.

client_id.description: OAuthClient ID that issued the token. Present only when `active` is `true` and the token was issued via the OAuth flow.

sub.description: Subject — the Aura Historia user ID who authorized the token. Present only when `active` is `true`.

exp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the token expires. Present only when `active` is `true` and the token has an expiry.

iat.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the token was issued. Present only when `active` is `true` and the issue time is known.

UserTierData.description:
The user's subscription tier, which determines limits and feature access (e.g. max watchlist entries, max search filters, allowed search filter fields).
- `FREE`: Default tier for all users. Allows up to 20 watchlist entries, up to 1 search filter (limited to `productQuery`, `price`, `state`, `excludeProductId`, and `lifecycle` filter fields), and up to 10 product matches per filter.
- `PRO`: Premium tier. Allows up to 100 watchlist entries, up to 5 search filters with access to all filter fields, and unlimited product matches per filter.
- `ULTIMATE`: Highest tier. Allows unlimited watchlist entries, unlimited search filters with access to all filter fields, and unlimited product matches per filter.

UserRoleData.description:
The user's role used for API authorization.
- `USER`: Standard authenticated user.
- `ADMIN`: Administrator with access to admin-only endpoints.

NotificationPayloadData.description: Reason-specific immutable snapshot. Its shape is selected by the parent `NotificationData.kind`.

oldPrice.description: Previous asking-price assertion. Null when unavailable.

newPrice.description: New asking-price assertion. Null when unavailable.

CreateProductListingData.description: Data for creating a single product via the partner batch-create endpoint.

sourceListingId.description: The listing source's own identifier for the product. Must be unique within the listing source.

price.description: Optional asking-price assertion for the product.

priceEstimateMin.description: Optional lower bound of the estimated price range

priceEstimateMax.description: Optional upper bound of the estimated price range

availability.description: Omit or send `null` when Aura has no reliable current availability assertion.

url.description: URL to the product on the listing source's website

images.description: List of image URLs for the product. May be empty.

auction.description: Omit for no Auction or lot changes, or send an asserted nested Auction/lot-facts patch. `null` is invalid. `auctionId` must identify an existing Auction for this ListingSource.

PartnerProductListingBatchFailuresRespon.description:
Failed entries from a synchronous partner-product batch. This response body is returned
with HTTP 200 only when at least one entry in a non-empty batch succeeded.

UpdateProductListingData.description:
Data for synchronously updating one ProductListing. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
`availability: null` clears the current assertion and `price: null` clears price. Omit `auction` to preserve
its context; `auction: null`, `url: null`, and `images: null` are invalid. Send `images: []` to remove all images.

sourceListingId.description: The listing source's own identifier for the product to update. Product existence is evaluated synchronously.

price.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send null to clear the current asking-price assertion.

availability.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send null to clear the current assertion.

priceEstimateMin.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send null to clear the current value.

priceEstimateMax.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send null to clear the current value.

url.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Null is invalid.

images.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send [] to remove all images; null is invalid.

auction.description: Omit to leave unchanged. Send an object to apply nested lot/timing leaf patches. `auctionId` must identify an existing Auction for this ListingSource; omit it to preserve membership, send null to clear it, or send an ID to set it. `null` for `auction` is invalid.

UpsertProductListingData.description:
Data for synchronously upserting one ProductListing. Only `sourceListingId` is required.
Availability, price, and each price estimate are tri-state: omitted preserves an existing
value, `null` clears it, and a concrete value replaces it. The nested Auction/lot-facts patch is omitted
to preserve stored facts or supplied as a leaf patch; `null` is invalid. Within an asserted patch, lot/timing leaves
omit to preserve, use `null` to clear, or provide a value to set. `auctionId` must identify an existing Auction for this ListingSource; omit it to preserve membership, send `null` to clear it, or send an ID to set it. Upsert restores a withdrawn listing before current
facts apply. Images and URL use the field-specific rules documented below.

sourceListingId.description: The listing source's own identifier for the product. Must be unique within the listing source.

title.description: Optional localized title for the product. Used only when creating a new product.

description.description: Optional localized description of the product. Used only when creating a new product.

price.description: Optional current asking-price assertion. Omit to leave it unchanged; send null to clear it; send a tagged monetary or on-request value to set it. On creation, omitted and null both mean no assertion.

priceEstimateMin.description: Optional lower bound of the estimated price range. On an existing listing, omit to preserve, send `null` to clear, or send a value to set. On creation, omitted and `null` both mean no lower bound.

priceEstimateMax.description: Optional upper bound of the estimated price range. On an existing listing, omit to preserve, send `null` to clear, or send a value to set. On creation, omitted and `null` both mean no upper bound.

availability.description: Omit to preserve an existing assertion; send null to clear it; send a code to set it.

url.description: URL to the product on the listing source's website. On an existing listing, omit or send `null` to preserve the current URL; send a value to replace it. URL is non-clearable.

images.description: List of image URLs for the product. On an existing listing, omit to preserve the stored image set, send `[]` to clear it, or send an array to replace it. `null` is invalid.

auction.description: Omit to preserve the current context or send an object to apply nested leaf patches. `auctionId` must identify an existing Auction for this ListingSource; omit it to preserve membership, send null to clear it, or send an ID to set it. `null` for `auction` is invalid.

WoocommerceProductWebhookImageData.description: Image object extracted from a WooCommerce product payload.

src.description: Absolute URL of a product image.

WoocommerceProductWebhookUpsertData.description:
WooCommerce product payload accepted for `product.created` and `product.updated`.
Every event requires `id`. `status: publish` captures an UPSERT and requires nonblank `name` and `permalink`.
`status: trash`, `draft`, `pending`, or `private` captures a DELETE and requires only `id`; missing or
unsupported status is authorized ignored input and also requires only `id`.

id.description: WooCommerce product identifier. It is converted to the internal `sourceListingId`.

name.description: Nonblank product title required only when `status: publish` captures an UPSERT.

permalink.description: Public URL required only when `status: publish` captures an UPSERT.

description.description: Optional HTML product description. The backend converts it to plain text for indexing.

short_description.description: Optional HTML short description used when `description` is absent.

price.description:
Optional WooCommerce price string for a captured `status: publish` UPSERT.
Intake writes current raw-values schema `1` with `MACHINE_DECIMAL`. A nonblank value must be an untrimmed unsigned ASCII decimal
(`digits` or `digits.digits`): no whitespace, signs, grouping separators, or currency symbols. A nonblank
`SET` requires the listing source's configured `woocommerceCurrency`. Fractional digits beyond the configured
currency minor-unit scale are accepted only when every excess digit is `0`; a nonzero excess digit is
rejected rather than truncated. A blank source string maps to `CLEAR`.

status.description:
Optional WooCommerce product status string.
`publish` captures an UPSERT and requires nonblank `name` and `permalink`. `draft`, `pending`,
`private`, and `trash` capture a DELETE and require only `id`. Unsupported or missing status is
authorized ignored input: it causes no destructive write and does not require `name` or `permalink`.

stock_status.description:
Optional WooCommerce stock-status string.
For `publish`, `instock` maps to `IN_STOCK`, `outofstock` to `OUT_OF_STOCK`, and
`onbackorder` to `BACK_ORDER`. Missing or unsupported stock status never implies a sale.

date_modified_gmt.description: Optional WooCommerce product modification timestamp. When the topic/status maps to raw capture, accepted forms are no-offset GMT interpreted as UTC, RFC3339 `Z`, and RFC3339 `+00:00`; malformed or nonzero-offset values are rejected. A valid value establishes provider source order; omit it when no source-ordering guarantee is available.

images.description: Optional list of WooCommerce product images. Missing payload fields are treated as an empty list.

WoocommerceProductWebhookDeleteData.description:
WooCommerce product payload accepted for `product.deleted`.
Only `id` is required. If `name` or `permalink` are provided they may still be used by the backend,
but the event remains valid with just the product ID.

id.description: WooCommerce product identifier. It is converted to the internal `sourceListingId`.

date_modified_gmt.description: Optional WooCommerce product modification timestamp. Accepted forms are no-offset GMT interpreted as UTC, RFC3339 `Z`, and RFC3339 `+00:00`; nonzero offsets are rejected. A valid value establishes provider source order; omit it when no source-ordering guarantee is available.
